items.title: Website update
items.text:
The website has been updated; the following has been added:
1. The text ‘xeuqra.com’ has appeared next to the logo, complete with an animation
2. A new page, ‘Others’, has been added; ===> it features a new interview with the co-founder of the Xiroach label, dated 10 September 2026.
